title: Network Effect — Bounded Session in an Unfinishable Archive
subtitle: Rapid archival grazing under a strict session countdown clock until forced return to quiet outside air
lineage: Lineage: Jonathan Harris & Greg Hochmuth, Network Effect (2015)
theorem: Expose the restlessness of infinite archival browsing by imposing a strict session timer: move through categorized human behaviors (`EATING`, `STARING`, `WATCHING TV`, `MULTI-SCREEN OVERLOAD`) while the countdown runs out, then enforce a quiet offline horizon.
boundary_note: The session countdown (`SESSION REMAINING: 24s -> 00s [LOCKOUT]`) is rendered in the HUD, ending on an unmediated outdoor shoreline (`4deab11b`).
